name: @amykit/plugin-file-queue
description: A queue kept as one file per item, claimed by rename.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Every install that runs an engine needs a queue, and this is the local one: each item is a file, claimed by renaming it so a loop never takes an item another one holds. Items are taken in id order or by priority. Pair it with file-store and an engine.
